prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY sprite packing of the supplied transparent atlas. Preserve exactly the same NINE object identities, painted style, colors, materials and alpha silhouettes. Output a square3×3 sprite sheet with mathematically EQUAL cells. Each object including its shadow must fit entirely in the CENTER70% of its assigned cell, with at least15% transparent margin on ALL FOUR SIDES of every cell. Nothing crosses a cell boundary. Row1 entirely above y=one-third; row2 entirely between one-third and two-thirds; row3 entirely below two-thirds. No labels, grid lines, backdrop, rectangle ground platforms or checkerboard. Actual transparent RGBA background. Left-to-right top-to-bottom identities: cactus; agave; prickly-pear; aloe; desert-flowers; dry-grass; scrub; reeds; saltflat. Reduce large objects uniformly so tree foliage, cactus bases and mountain bases all have generous breathing room; no cropping.
